EquipmentLibrary.Description: XCGF standard library: signature definitions. A signature tells how detectable its platform is. Aircraft signatures follow CMO: visual and infrared detection ranges and two radar cross sections (bands A-D and E-M), each given for the front, side, rear and top aspects (see docs/cmo-mapping.md).

EquipmentDefinition.name: Signature
EquipmentDefinition.Description: Root signature: physical dimensions of the platform. Every signature derives from it.

Parameter.name: Dimensions
Parameter.Description: Length, span and height of the platform.

EquipmentDefinition.name: AircraftSignature
EquipmentDefinition.Description: Aircraft signature: visual, infrared and radar, per aspect.

Parameter.name: Visual
Parameter.Description: Range at which the aircraft is seen by eye in daylight, per aspect. Visual sensors scale it by their generation.

Parameter.name: Infrared
Parameter.Description: Range at which a reference infrared sensor detects the aircraft, per aspect. Infrared sensors scale it by their generation.

Parameter.name: RadarCrossSectionAToD
Parameter.Description: Radar cross section seen by radars in bands A to D (below 2 GHz), per aspect.

Parameter.name: RadarCrossSectionEToM
Parameter.Description: Radar cross section seen by radars in bands E to M (2 GHz and above), per aspect.
